status: Planning caps only; GPU/training budgets require explicit approval

student_ablations.requires: Separately approved jobs with equal total updates and exact data/config hashes

development_confirmation.requires: Enumerated job matrix and budget based on measured median time

heldout.requires: Frozen finalist hashes and approved total job/time budget

expansion_rule: A bounded pilot does not authorize additional seeds, ablations or full training; profile before estimating total campaign cost
failure_rule: No automatic retry with changed batch, resolution, precision or model policy
